subject: STRING statement
notes: kb/Work PB1181 (wave 1011 A). SR3 'Literal-2 shall not be a zero-length literal.' (cite.py --check 14.9.43.3 -> OK 3)). The ONE IsZeroLengthLiteral predicate (plain, hexadecimal, national and ALL forms) is asked of the DELIMITED BY literal and refused through Reject (COBOL1651); the run-time kernel had read a zero-length delimiter as DELIMITED BY SIZE, GR3 b)'s rule for a zero-length IDENTIFIER-2. The zero-length literal is legal at editions where the lexer admits it; the screen is edition-invariant (PB895 owns the --std 85 lexical question).
